title: Normalized ordinary integral input interfaces
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and its published adic datum [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. For schemes T and U and h:U→T define the coefficient-edge conditions (invertible projection-preserving coefficient map, exact ordinary module pullback, adjunction, and uniquely tensor-unit-normalized inverse-image identification); membership agreement with both stratified-perfect presentations; the module and derived pullback comparison normalized by the adjunction generators and derived computation counits; the transported actual strict quotient tower, its counit and augmentation; and its Roos coordinate comparison. Model matching means that the tower comparison respects the actual augmentations and both cone coordinates, and for every K-injective resolution with injective terms the derived comparison is computed using the limit inclusion (limit projections,0) followed by the Roos map of the resolution. Completion matching means that this same model comparison identifies the ordinary completion comparison with the actual strict-tower completion unit after every presentation isomorphism. These are exactly the thirteen existing interfaces extracted verbatim from the ordinary input module; no data or mathematical condition changes. [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback, def-sf-ordinary-integral-pullback-construction, def-sf-ordinary-integral-derived-pullback, lem-tw-integral-comparison-descent, lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization].
